verificationSelection.rationale: This bootstrap uses an existing append-only controller to project exact human approval. Its material risks are authority binding, unauthorized path changes, predecessor mutation, false activation and misleading current state. Exact Git and backlog comparison, fresh submitted-state validation, and inspected status/site evidence address those risks. The producer's focused controller tests and full generated-site check are retained as submitted evidence rather than misrepresented as fresh reviewer runs.
